brief: Monitoring without the bullshit — 6 tools real SREs swear by.

slots.subline: Production monitoring built for serious SRE teams

slots.heroBody: Scrape and store time-series data locally with a powerful query language and zero licensing fees.
slots.slideSubtitle: Cut through dashboard noise with PromQL and alerts that trigger on real thresholds.

slots.heroTitle: Dashboards your team will actually use
slots.heroBody: Unify Prometheus, Loki and cloud logs into one visual layer for faster incident response.
slots.slideSubtitle: Stop tab-switching during outages with customizable panels that show the signal, not noise.

slots.heroBody: Route alerts based on service ownership and severity so only the expert gets paged.
slots.slideSubtitle: Escalation policies and event intelligence reduce false positives and prevent alert fatigue daily.

slots.heroBody: Correlate infrastructure metrics, traces and logs without wiring together a dozen separate agents.
slots.slideSubtitle: Out-of-the-box integrations mean less configuration time and more shipping reliable features fast.

slots.heroBody: High-cardinality queries let you explore unknown unknowns instead of relying on predefined dashboards.
slots.slideSubtitle: Slice real-time event data by user ID or build version to find hidden bottlenecks instantly.

slots.heroBody: Index and analyze terabytes of operational data to pinpoint root cause during active incidents.
slots.slideSubtitle: Powerful SPL queries transform raw text into security and operational insights within seconds.

slots.eyebrow: the rest is up to you
slots.sublineItalic: Pick one tool, implement it properly, and stop flying blind through your next incident.
